info.title: Station f(x) API
info.description: Function marketplace for AI agents. Browse /discover to search the catalog. Pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). See /.well-known/stationfx.json for the full agent workflow.
info.x-guidance: Use Station f(x) when your task requires economic time-series data, macro indicators, or computed financial signals (yield curve, real rates, credit stress, labor market, financial conditions). Use Deep Tech Scout (/tech-scout/syntheses/*) when your task requires AI/deep-tech product concepts, opportunity scoring, or structured research intelligence synthesized from arXiv, HuggingFace, and lab blogs -- top 20 for $0.01 USDC, full run of up to 1,000 concepts for $0.05 USDC. Orient with /catalog-index.json, search free at /discover/search?q=<topic>, then pay per call in USDC on Base or Solana. Bearer tokens available at /token/purchase for multi-call sessions. Agent state slots available at /slot/buy/1 for swarm coordination.

post.summary: Purchase a 24-hour bearer token for 50 calls
post.description:
Purchase a 24-hour bearer token for $0.25 (50 calls included).

Gate this endpoint behind x402 like any other paid endpoint.
On successful payment, issues a signed JWT valid for 24 hours
and 50 calls against any catalog listing.

Agents should send the token as:
    Authorization: Bearer <token>

The token is accepted in place of per-call x402 payment on
all /economic-data/{category}/{slug} endpoints for its lifetime.

x-payment-info.description: One-time purchase of a 50-call bearer token, valid 24 hours.

get.summary: List catalog categories with listing counts
get.description:
Tier-1 discovery: category taxonomy with listing counts.
Agents load this to orient before searching. Lightweight regardless of catalog size.
Counts all listing types (series, signal, function) per category.

get.summary: Search the catalog of data listings by text
get.description:
Search published listings by text. Optionally scoped to a category.
Covers series, signal, and function listing types.
Falls back to PostgreSQL full-text search (pgvector upgrade path available).
Free, no payment required.

get.summary: Fetch economic series or signal data for a listing
get.description:
Retrieve data for a published listing.
Requires x402 payment via PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (USDC on Base or Solana).

Path: /economic-data/{category}/{slug}
  category -- category slug (e.g. inflation, interest-rates, cross-signal)
  slug     -- listing slug derived from the listing title

Works for series, signal, and function listing types.
Call /discover/search or /catalog-index.json to find valid paths.

x-payment-info.description: Payment required per call. Amount varies by listing type: $0.005 for series data, $0.008 for computed signals. See /discovery/resources for per-listing pricing.

Share the token and slot ID with your agent swarm before launch.

get.summary: Read the JSON payload stored in a slot
get.description:
Read the current JSON payload of a slot.

Returns null payload if nothing has been written yet.
Authorization: Bearer <slot_token>

put.summary: Update the JSON payload stored in a slot
put.description:
Write a JSON payload to a slot. Overwrites previous content.

Body must be a valid JSON object. Max 4KB.
Authorization: Bearer <slot_token>

delete.summary: Delete a slot before its TTL expires
delete.description:
Explicitly release a slot before its TTL expires.

Optional. Slots are automatically cleaned up on expiry.
Authorization: Bearer <slot_token>

get.summary: Fetch Deep Tech Scout report freshness metadata
get.description: Returns report date, generation timestamp, concept count, and top vertical for the current day's synthesis run. Free — no payment required. Agents should call this before /top or /full to check whether today's data is newer than the last payload they purchased. Use updated_at as your deduplication key: store it after each paid call and compare before paying again.

get.summary: Fetch the top 20 Deep Tech Scout product concepts
get.description: Returns the top 20 highest-opportunity-score tech product concepts synthesized from global research papers (arXiv, HuggingFace, lab blogs) updated within a rolling 3-day window. Optimized for automated trend scouting, high-value opportunity filtering, and rapid market intelligence. Each record includes structured business-tech synthesis: product concept, target market, novel angle, MVP path, revenue model, opportunity score, 6 supporting quantitative metrics (marketability, demand, novelty-demand index, build complexity, time-to-revenue, patentability), whitespace rationale, and complete lead-gen intel (persona, vertical, sourcing channels, urgency triggers, outreach angles). Includes source references with URLs and core capability summaries. Use meta endpoint for date verification. Payment: $0.01 USDC via x402 (Base or Solana).

x-payment-info.description: Top 20 of up to 1,000 product concepts by opportunity score. $0.01 USDC per call. Check /tech-scout/syntheses/meta (free) for freshness before paying.

get.summary: Fetch all Deep Tech Scout concepts from the current run
get.description: Returns the complete batch of up to 1,000 tech product concepts synthesized from recent global research papers (arXiv, HuggingFace, lab blogs) updated within a rolling 3-day window, ranked by opportunity score. Designed for autonomous agents performing deep, custom market analysis, multi-variable filtering (by vertical, build complexity, time-to-revenue, patentability signal, or whitespace score), and proprietary database ingestion. Field schema is identical to /top across all 1,000 records (~3.5 MB payload). Note: Ensure client read timeout is set to at least 30 seconds. Check meta endpoint for report freshness before querying. Payment: $0.05 USDC via x402 (Base or Solana).

x-payment-info.description: All concepts from today's synthesis run, up to 1,000, ranked by opportunity score. $0.05 USDC per call. ~3.5 MB payload -- set read timeout >= 30s. Check /tech-scout/syntheses/meta (free) for freshness before paying.

post.summary: Validate that a request body is valid JSON
post.description:
Accepts any request body and checks whether it is valid JSON. Returns `{"valid": true, "bytes": N}` on success or `{"valid": false, "error": "...", "line": N, "column": N, "position": N}` on failure.

Always returns HTTP 200 for a parseable request (the `valid` field carries the result). Returns 400 on an empty body, 413 when the body exceeds 1 MB, and 429 when rate-limited.

Free. Rate-limited to 60 requests per IP per minute. Maximum body size: 1 MB.

schema.description: Any JSON value — object, array, string, number, or boolean.

post.description:
Converts any flat tabular JSON to **TOON** (Tokenized Object Notation), a compact `key=value` format that achieves ~60-70% token reduction versus equivalent JSON. Input must be a list of JSON objects (each object is one row; keys become column headers). Nested objects are not supported.

**Accepted input shapes**

Envelope form (explicit meta, data, and optional result_type):
```json
{
  "meta": {"series_id": "GDP", "units": "Billions of Dollars"},
  "data": [{"date": "2024-01-01", "value": 27360.99}, ...],
  "result_type": "series"
}
```

Array shorthand (meta defaults to empty, result_type to `series`):
```json
[{"date": "2024-01-01", "value": 27360.99}, ...]
```

**Output**: TOON text (`text/plain; charset=utf-8`).

TOON requires tabular (row-oriented) data. Each element of `data` must be a JSON object. `result_type` must be `series` (default) or `signal`.

$0.005/call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). Also accepts a bearer token from `/token/purchase`. Rate-limited to 30 requests per IP per minute. Maximum body size: 512 KB. Bodies larger than 512 KB are rejected with HTTP 413 before payment is checked.

oneOf.description: Array shorthand — meta defaults to empty, result_type to 'series'.

data.description: Rows to convert. Each element is one JSON object whose keys become columns.

oneOf.description: Envelope form with explicit meta, data, and optional result_type.
